summary: Preview regression completed. Backend API suite passed all 4 tests; signup, authenticated dashboard, bulk CSV validation/deduplication, empty test-recipient blocking, mocked test send, confirmation, completion, logout, and mobile navigation passed.
action_items: No product fixes identified. The initial mobile run used a hidden sidebar nav selector; use the visible bulk card or open the mobile menu in future tests.
seed_data_creation: Created fresh temporary signup accounts and campaigns; no seeded data modified. Email delivery endpoints are MOCKED by design.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Bulk empty/malformed test recipient validation and React console warning regression passed in the live preview. Full backend regression passed.
rca of the issue: The reported client validation fix is effective: campaignTest returns before Axios when the trimmed recipient is empty or fails the email pattern, displaying the field error and making no API submission. Stable map keys are present; no React missing-key warning was observed during the successful UI run.
